fact: On 17 September 2024 the Anosy court convicted blogger Patrick Raharimanana of interception of computer data and publishing documents compromising national security, sentencing him to five years suspended and a 2 million ariary fine over his Facebook post of the president's agenda (the law is not named in the text).
title: Un blogueur malgache condamné à 5 ans de prison avec sursis pour avoir diffusé l'agenda présidentiel
